failure_basis.interpretation: The current harness already has one PowerShell host. Avoiding the NetTCPIP command module is a narrow proposed reduction; the failure receipt does not pinpoint the crossing instruction or measure this proposal's memory savings.

source_comparison.modified_function: Initialize-OwnedJob adds only native TCP table declarations and ListenerOwners.
source_comparison.modified_main_lines: The listener query returns owner PIDs instead of cmdlet objects; the unchanged requirement remains at least one owner and every owner equal to the retained server PID.

tcp_adapter_review.p_invoke: GetExtendedTcpTable returns a DWORD status, receives a pointer and in/out DWORD length, an explicitly marshaled BOOL, address family, table class and reserved zero. The result code directly determines errors.
tcp_adapter_review.source_contract: The Microsoft table-class enumeration selects owner-PID listeners for both families. Both families are queried; matching wildcard, concrete-address and duplicate listeners are all retained.
tcp_adapter_review.layout_method: Sequential SDK-equivalent DWORD/inline-byte-array fields feed Marshal.SizeOf and OffsetOf. Explicit expected offsets/strides refuse an unexpected runtime layout. Count plus full rows must fit the API-reported used length, which must fit the allocation.
tcp_adapter_review.port_decoding: The first two bytes of the network-order local-port field are combined high byte first. Unused DWORD bytes are not interpreted as part of the 16-bit port.
tcp_adapter_review.ownership: The native adapter returns every matching positive owner PID, without deduplication or address filtering. PowerShell requires a nonempty result and rejects any PID different from the already-retained server Process.Id.
refusal_cases: Initial size query result other than the documented insufficient-buffer response.
Returned length outside the owned allocation.
Any non-listener row in the listener-class table.
Nonpositive owner for a matching port.
A changing table that does not settle in three attempts.
A two-family query finishing at or after the 500 ms success deadline.
No matching listener or any foreign owner.
tcp_adapter_review.timing_limit: The 500 ms check is a completion/refusal bound around synchronous native calls, not an interruptible per-call timer. The unchanged independent hard Job deadline and Scheduler backstop remain active.
